# Compath OÜ

> Compath OÜ in Tallinn: IT support and maintenance for companies and homes, WordPress plugin development, AI agents and workflow automation, and consulting on launching on Amazon.

Compath OÜ is a company in Tallinn, Estonia (Ahtri 12, 10151). Registry code 11502963. VAT EE101244231. Phone +372 55520482. Hours Monday–Friday 09:00–17:00.

The company has three services. It does not offer translation or video production.

## Services

### English

- [Services](https://compath.ee/services/): IT support in Tallinn, WordPress plugin development and AI agents, and consulting on launching on Amazon. Compath OÜ, Ahtri 12.
- [IT support and maintenance](https://compath.ee/services/it-support/): IT support in Tallinn for companies and homes: networks, computers and office equipment, domains, hosting, e-mail, websites, VoIP and ongoing maintenance.
- [Plugin and AI agent development](https://compath.ee/services/plugins-and-ai/): WordPress plugin development in Estonia, plus AI agents and workflow automation such as n8n integrations. Compath OÜ also publishes Choir Rehearsal.
- [Consulting on launching on Amazon](https://compath.ee/services/amazon-launch/): Consulting on launching on Amazon: account setup, listings, and advertising (PPC) basics. Compath OÜ advises. You remain the seller.

### Eesti

- [Teenused](https://compath.ee/et/teenused/): IT tugi Tallinnas, WordPressi pluginate arendus ja tehisintellekti agendid ning nõustamine Amazoni käivitamisel. Compath OÜ, Ahtri 12.
- [IT tugi ja hooldus](https://compath.ee/et/teenused/it-tugi/): IT tugi Tallinnas ettevõtetele ja kodudele: arvutivõrgud, arvutid ja kontoritehnika, domeenid, majutus, e-post, veebilehed, VoIP ja jooksev hooldus.
- [Pluginate ja tehisintellekti agentide arendus](https://compath.ee/et/teenused/pluginad-ja-tehisintellekt/): WordPressi pluginate arendus ning tehisintellekti agendid ja töövoogude automatiseerimine, näiteks n8n. Compath OÜ avaldab ka pluginat Choir Rehearsal.
- [Nõustamine Amazoni käivitamisel](https://compath.ee/et/teenused/amazon/): Nõustamine Amazoni käivitamisel: konto seadistus, kuulutused ja reklaami (PPC) põhitõed. Compath OÜ nõustab. Müüja olete teie.

### Русский

- [Услуги](https://compath.ee/ru/uslugi/): IT поддержка в Таллине, разработка плагинов WordPress и ИИ-агентов, консультации по запуску на Amazon. Compath OÜ, Ahtri 12.
- [ИТ-поддержка и сопровождение](https://compath.ee/ru/uslugi/it-podderzhka/): IT поддержка в Таллине для компаний и дома: сети, компьютеры и оргтехника, домены, хостинг, почта, сайты, VoIP и текущее сопровождение.
- [Разработка плагинов и ИИ-агентов](https://compath.ee/ru/uslugi/plaginy-i-ii/): Разработка плагинов WordPress, ИИ-агенты и автоматизация процессов, например интеграции n8n. Compath OÜ также выпускает Choir Rehearsal.
- [Консультации по запуску на Amazon](https://compath.ee/ru/uslugi/amazon/): Консультации по запуску на Amazon: настройка аккаунта, карточки товаров и основы рекламы (PPC). Compath OÜ консультирует. Продавец — вы.

## Choir Rehearsal

Choir Rehearsal is Compath’s own WordPress plugin: a private rehearsal library for choirs (songs, per-voice tracks, PDF scores, YouTube embeds). Lite is free. Pro is €49/year. Role names Singer, Voice Leader and Administrator are never translated.

- [English](https://compath.ee/choir-rehearsal/)
- [Eesti](https://compath.ee/et/choir-rehearsal/)
- [Русский](https://compath.ee/ru/choir-rehearsal/)
- Product site: https://rehearsal.compath.ee/
- Estonian product site: https://rehearsal.compath.ee/?lang=et
- Russian product site: https://rehearsal.compath.ee/?lang=ru
- English product site: https://rehearsal.compath.ee/?lang=en
- Live demo: https://demo.rehearsal.compath.ee/rehearsal
- Lite: https://wordpress.org/plugins/compath-choir-rehearsal/
- Pro: https://shop.compath.ee/products/choir-rehearsal-pro/
